Name: Furniture Framework
Author: Leroymilo
Description:
[size=6][color=#ff5555]The Furniture Framework 3.3 Update is Out![/color][/size]

[size=5][color=#ff55ff]New: Extended compatibility with other mods and C# API[/color][/size]
[size=3]Appart from some bug fixes, this update does not have much external changes, but it comes with an API to allow other mods to request information about Furniture made with FF to improve compatibility.
For now, only Astraios' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41844]BroadcastAPI[/url] and Mushymato's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42801]Merchant[/url] are using it, but I am completely open to add features for this API, so don't hesitate to ask if you want to make your mod more compatible with FF.[/size]

[size=5]Image Credits:[/size]
[size=3]The Example Pack for the Furniture Framework (by myself)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24224]StarAmy's Museum Furniture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25086]StarAmy's Bakery Displays[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25432]Pear wood carving flower[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30864]Misty Orchid Fragrant Purple[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23677]Lynn's Livingroom[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24275]Lynn's Bedroom[/url][/size]

[size=5]If you are a mod user:[/size]
[size=3]This is a Framework mod to make Furniture Packs, if you are using a mod requiring this Framework and you are encountering a bug, please report it to the Furniture Pack author.
[color=#ff5555]If you see an error about a Furniture Pack having outdated Format, it simply means that the packs you are using are not up to date. You can either uninstall the outdated pack until they get updated, or revert to a 2.x version of FF [/color] (you can find the file under the most recent update).[/size]

[size=5]If you are a Furniture Pack author:[/size]
[size=3]Make sure to read [url=https://github.com/Leroymilo/FurnitureFramework/blob/main/doc]the documentation[/url] before reporting bugs or asking question. I also started writing a [url=https://leroymilo.neocities.org/tutorials/FF_getting_started]"getting started" guide[/url] (more sections to come).

If you think you encountered a bug, you can report it on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458?tab=bugs]this mod page[/url], or on the [url=https://github.com/Leroymilo/FurnitureFramework/issues]GitHub repository[/url]. Make sure to include the [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url], the [url=https://smapi.io/json]content.json[/url] and/or screenshots in the bug report. Feel free to ping me on the [url=https://discord.com/channels/137344473976799233/156109690059751424]Stardew Valley discord's modding channel[/url] if I don't notice the bug report.

If you want help to make a Furniture Pack or have questions about the documentation, please come ask it on the [url=https://discord.com/channels/137344473976799233/156109690059751424]Stardew Valley discord's modding channel[/url] by pinging me.[/size]

[size=5]What can this Framework do that Content Patcher can't?[/size]
[size=3]Here's a list of what you can customize thanks to this Framework:
[list]
[*]Custom Description
[*]Custom Rotations
[*]Custom Bounding Box size
[*]Custom Collision map
[*]Custom Layers
[*]Custom Seats
[*]Custom Shop on click
[*]Custom Table Slots
[*]Support for Sprites variants
[*]Support for Source Rectangle variants (variants on the same sprite-sheet)
[*]Custom Menu Icon
[*]Toggle-able Furniture (right click to change state)
[*]Custom Particles
[*]Support for animated base Sprite and Layers
[*]Support for some special Furniture (Dresser, TV, Bed and Fish-Tank)
[*]Support for Rugs
[*]Support for Wall-mounted Furniture
[*]Support for included files. Included files can be toggled with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[*]Custom Light Sources
[*]Custom categorization in the vanilla Furniture Catalogue
[*]Custom Storage Furniture (custom tabs and rules
[/list]

However, the Furniture Framework is not a replacement for Content Patcher; in fact, CP can be used to modify Furniture Packs and extend FF's features with CP dynamic tokens. You can learn how to do this in [url=https://github.com/Leroymilo/FurnitureFramework/blob/main/doc/Author.md#content-patcher-integration]this section[/url] of the documentation. FF also has its own i18n compatibility that you can learn to use in [url=https://github.com/Leroymilo/FurnitureFramework/blob/main/doc/Author.md#i18n-integration]this section[/url].

See also: [url=https://github.com/Leroymilo/FurnitureFramework/blob/main/doc/Changelogs.md]Changelogs[/url]﻿

The key to place an item in or remove it from a slot is configurable with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], it is now also possible to activate a Furniture placed in a Slot.[/size]
